headline: Trump says US will help with traffic buildup in Strait of Hormuz
summary: US President Donald Trump said the United States will help with the buildup of shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. He had agreed to a two-week ceasefire with Iran shortly before his deadline.
why: Shipping flows through Hormuz carry a large share of global seaborne oil, so changes in transit conditions affect energy markets and freight costs.

source.name: WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM | Wausau, Stevens Point
